resources.title: IBM Data Science Certification Guide
resources.content:
#IBM Data Science Certification An Exclusive Opportunity for Female Candidates!!! Gear up to enhance your career with the upcoming **IBM Data Science Certification** (Duration: **3 hours**) - absolutely **free of cost**.
**Benefits you can't miss out on** - **Job Fair Eligibility**: Secure your spot at the exclusive Job Fair being conducted by *Aspire For Her organization* in *October 2023* for **female** candidates (***Get IBM certificate to gain a spot***)! - **Impress Employers**: Catch the eye of top recruiters with tangible achievements. - **Access to Free Courses**: Continue your learning journey with unlimited access to IBM SkillsBuild courses.
Ready to take the leap? Please follow these steps:
** 1. Fill the Interest Expression Form** Fill this form now to express your interest: Interest Expression Form
**2. Know more about the IBM Data Science Certification** Watch this video for comprehensive details on the certification, IBM Skill Build platform usage, and other relevant insights.
**3. Course Completion & Certification** - Register on SkillsBuild (**mandatory**, so we can register you as a learner) - SkillsBuild Registration - Complete the IBM Data Science 101 Course - Course Link
**4. Upload Your completion certificate ** - Don't forget to upload your certificate here: Certificate Upload Form - Select **NxtWave** in the **Which college are you from?** field (at the end of the list)
Have any queries or facing any issues, you can reach out to NxtWave Learner Support at http://bit.ly/2Zo1eNS
All the Best!!
